_readme: World pickups and keepsake displays (Campaign Foundation T11). Loaded by PickupCatalogueAsset; PickupCatalogue.BuiltIn() holds the same data as a fallback.
pickups: id (stable; its claim campaignId/levelId/id/pickup is saved once per campaign), itemId (inventory.json), levelId, quantity,
availableAfter ("" or an objectives key the introduction raises, e.g. event:ReceptionistTalkedTo), title, lines (short neutral text, never an answer),
plaque (the label on its tray), spot (parent scene path, surface object name, optional near prop to tell same-named surfaces apart).
The tray rests on the surface's top at the spot with the most room (PickupRules.BestSpot), the same on every load.
displays: id (the anchor saved with a displayed keepsake), levelId, category accepted, title, spot.
Optional pickups never give coins, trust, XP, a badge or an answer, and required records always come from their own handover.

pickups.title: COAST TALES
lines: The ferry horn still sounds at six, and the fish market opens before the sun is up.
Someone from the Coast Tales club left this here to welcome you to the island.
